gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. KH 3009/1, commencing at its junction with Hoi Bun Road and Hung Yip Street, running westward for approximately 140 m and terminating at its junction with the road shown coloured yellow on the said Drawing.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路在 KH 3009/1 號圖則上以粉紅色標明，起點在海濱道與鴻業街交界處，向西伸展約一百四十米，終點在上述圖則以黃色標明道路之交界處。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac, as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. KH 3009/1, commencing at its junction with the road shown coloured pink on the said Drawing, running northward for a distance of about 85 m.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路為盡頭路，在 KH 3009/1 號圖則上以黃色標明，起點在上述圖則以粉紅色標明道路交界處，向北伸展約八十五米。
